title: Height data
whatTitle: What the height model is for
whatIntro: A height model (DEM) is a measured grid of the ground's height. Oxygen fetches the part under each club map on the server, once, and keeps it with the map. The map's 3D view uses it for:
whatGround: the real ground surface, as an alternative to the surface Oxygen derives from the map's own contours;
whatAnchor: absolute heights for the map's own terrain: each contour is anchored to the model, so the 3D terrain stands at true heights above sea level with fewer contour artefacts;
whatTracks: GPS tracks drawn on the real ground.
whatOptIn: Nothing is fetched until a provider is switched on below.
lmDesc: Sweden's national height model (Markhöjdmodell), at 2 m or 1 m. Free open data under CC BY 4.0. Needs a Geotorget account.
gloDesc: Worldwide, 30 m, no account. A coarse surface model, used wherever Lantmäteriet has no coverage or is off.
accountHow1: Create a user on Lantmäteriet's Geotorget.
accountHow2: Order the free product Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning for that user.
accountHow3: Enter that user name and password below. The password is stored encrypted, is never shown again and is sent only to Lantmäteriet.
attribution: Whenever the 3D view draws Lantmäteriet's heights, the map shows “© Lantmäteriet” (CC BY 4.0), as the licence requires.
testHow: Test connection fetches the height data under one club map with the saved account and checks that Lantmäteriet accepts it, that the download answers partial (range) requests and keeps the account on Lantmäteriet's own servers, that the tiles are in a format Oxygen reads and have a 2 m level, and that the 2 m model anchors the map's contours as well as the 1 m model. It reads about 100 MB, takes a minute or two and changes nothing. If it fails, choose 1 m below.
lmNeedsAccount: Lantmäteriet is switched on but has no account: it stays off until one is saved.
warning_account-unreadable: The saved account can no longer be read. Enter it again.
warning_lantmateriet-bad-account: The deploy's Lantmäteriet credential is not of the form user:password; Lantmäteriet is off.
warning_unknown-provider: The provider list names a provider Oxygen does not know; it is ignored.
warning_bad-resolution: The deploy's resolution is neither 1 nor 2; 2 m is used.
requeued_one: {{count}} map that failed on the account is queued again.
requeued_other: {{count}} maps that failed on the account are queued again.
resolution2: 2 m (default: a third of the download)
testNoMaps: No club map can be tested: it needs a georeference and must be small enough to read at 1 m.
testError: The test could not run on {{map}}: {{error}}
check_spreadHolds: 2 m anchors the contours as well as 1 m
testAccepted: Accepted contour length: {{at1m}} % at 1 m, {{at2m}} % at 2 m
mapsEmpty: The club library has no maps yet.
reason_format: the tiles could not be read
reason_misaligned: the map does not line up with the model
reason_rotation-corrected: the map has a rotation correction

errorTestRunning: A connection test is already running.
